as_told.title: Death of Chris Evans on a West Virginia bridge

plain: Scott Ramsay, who researches a claimed crash of a craft with alien bodies, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that a fellow researcher named Chris Evans died on the very day he was coming to see Susanna, who works with Ramsay on the research. In one version Ramsay puts the death in 2005 on a bridge in West Virginia and cites a report from the state highway patrol, and he also mentions a person named Alice Scully. He tells it because the timing, if more than chance, would suggest someone did not want the meeting to happen.
